title: Crucible shadow.v2 — produce-time scored cross-section
description: The whole ranked cross-section an arm produced on one trading day, written at experiments/{arm}/{trading_day}/cross_section.json. `shadow.v1` (shadow.json, unchanged) persists only the top-N selection, which is enough to score a pick but not enough to compute a rank correlation. This document exists to make `crucible report`'s R/M attribution rows a true rank IC rather than the realized-excess-return stand-in named plan_row (alpha-engine-config-I9778). additionalProperties: false because a field this reader does not understand is a field the producer expected it to act on.

schema_version.description: Version of THIS schema. A consumer that cannot read the version refuses the document rather than guessing.

arm_id.description: `{slot}:{name}:{spec_hash}` — the same identity every other artifact in this tree addresses an arm by.

trading_day.description: The NYSE session the cross-section was scored on (§4.12).

population_size.description: len(ranks). Redundant with the array length by construction, and required anyway so a truncated array is a schema failure rather than a silently smaller population.

ranks.description: Every ticker the arm's ranker scored, ordered by DESCENDING score. Not necessarily sorted in the array — `rank` is the authoritative order.

rank.description: 1-based, dense: rank 1 is the highest score.
